Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class DeviceVerificationErrorHandler

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.DeviceVerificationErrorHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationFailureHandler
public class DeviceVerificationErrorHandler extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationFailureHandler
Error handler of the device verification endpoint. A user who owes a second factor goes where the authorization endpoint sends them (the secondFactorHandler); too many attempts are answered 429 with a Retry-After header; any other failure (an unknown, expired or already used code, a denied consent) sends the browser back to the verification page with ?error, which says nothing about the reason, so a code cannot be told apart from a wrong one. Installing a handler replaces the framework's, which only answers 400.
